survey.title: Rheumatologist Perceptions of Advanced Therapies in Moderate-to-Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis

sourceAnchor.quote: Which of the following advanced therapies do you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis?

obligations.requirement: Q1. Which of the following advanced therapies do you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis?
obligations.stimulus: Reach question Q1
expectedObservables: Question Q1 is displayed with text: "Which of the following advanced therapies do you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis?"
Answer input is of type checkbox
Option 1: "HUMIRA"
Option 2: "ENBREL"
Option 3: "RINVOQ"
Option 4: "XELJANZ"
Option 5: "ORENCIA"
Option 99: "None of the above"

sourceAnchor.quote: How satisfied are you with [PIPE: current L1 item] for your moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis patients?

obligations.requirement: Q2. How satisfied are you with [PIPE: current L1 item] for your moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis patients?
preconditions: Loop L1 is active for at least one item
obligations.stimulus: Reach question Q2
expectedObservables: Question Q2 is displayed with text: "How satisfied are you with {LOOP} for your moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis patients?"
Answer input is of type radio
Option 1: "Very satisfied"
Option 2: "Somewhat satisfied"
Option 3: "Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied"
Option 4: "Somewhat dissatisfied"
Option 5: "Very dissatisfied"
Repeats once per L1 loop item

sourceAnchor.quote: Allocate 100 points across the following factors according to how much each drives your choice of advanced therapy in moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis.
